name: Bedeyuto
source:
A neat-looking mage with long golden hair and blue eyes. He is never emotional and always wears a cold, thin smile.

He is a hedonistic eccentric who is indifferent to right and wrong and profit, and acts only out of curiosity. He is willing to sell or betray his friends because he likes chaos in a situation.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/selicia/index.html]official site[/url]]
